s0301.literal: Officials of the Gansu branch secretariat summoned Princes Baba, Baidahan, and Imperial Son-in-law Changji, joined forces to subdue them, and all bound themselves and pleaded guilty.
s0301.idiomatic: Gansu branch secretariat officials summoned Princes Baba, Baidahan, and Imperial Son-in-law Changji, joined forces to suppress them, and all bound themselves and pleaded guilty.

s0302.literal: Shiremen alone fled west with his followers; pursued to the land of Dolangbudai, intercepted and captured, and brought back to the capital.
s0302.idiomatic: Shiremen alone fled west with his followers; pursued to Dolangbudai, intercepted and captured, and brought back to the capital.

s0303.literal: On gengchen day the six guard military colonies suffered famine; grain for sixty days was supplied to three thousand relief troops.
s0303.idiomatic: On gengchen day famine struck the six guard military colonies; sixty days' grain was supplied to 3,000 relief troops.

s0304.literal: The king of Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
s0304.idiomatic: The king of Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

s0305.literal: Princes including Aiyagachar were granted one thousand liang of gold, eighteen thousand three hundred sixty liang of silver, ten thousand liang of silk, eighty-three thousand two hundred liang of cotton, one thousand two hundred bolts of gold-threaded plain silk, and five thousand ninety-eight bolts of silk.
s0305.idiomatic: Princes including Aiyagachar were granted 1,000 liang of gold, 18,360 liang of silver, 10,000 liang of silk, 83,200 liang of cotton, 1,200 bolts of gold-threaded plain silk, and 5,098 bolts of silk.

s0306.literal: Prince Aiyachi's dependents were granted paper notes, sheep, and horses totaling two hundred ninety-one thousand forty-seven ingots, twenty-six thousand nine hundred fourteen horses, one hundred thousand two hundred ten sheep, eight camels, and nine hundred oxen.
s0306.idiomatic: Prince Aiyachi's dependents were granted paper notes, sheep, and horses totaling 291,047 ingots, 26,914 horses, 100,210 sheep, 8 camels, and 900 oxen.

s0307.literal: Indigent princes were relief-granted two hundred ten thousand six hundred ingots of paper currency, six thousand seven hundred twenty-five horses, twelve thousand eight hundred fifty-seven sheep, and forty oxen.
s0307.idiomatic: Impoverished princes were given relief of 210,600 ingots of paper currency, 6,725 horses, 12,857 sheep, and 40 oxen.

s0308.literal: Those whose wives, children, and household property were lost to bandits were granted thirty-two thousand eight hundred eighty ingots of paper currency and one hundred horses and oxen; those who had supplied sheep, horses, and other goods for the army were compensated with one thousand six hundred seventy-four ingots, four thousand three hundred twenty-five horses, thirty-four thousand one hundred ninety-nine sheep, seventy-two camels, and thirty oxen.
s0308.idiomatic: Those whose wives, children, and household property were lost to bandits received 32,880 ingots of paper currency and 100 horses and oxen; those who had supplied sheep, horses, and other goods for the army were compensated with 1,674 ingots, 4,325 horses, 34,199 sheep, 72 camels, and 30 oxen.

s0309.literal: Those rescued from bandit captivity were rewarded with four thousand seventy-eight ingots of paper currency.
s0309.idiomatic: Those rescued from bandit captivity were rewarded with 4,078 ingots of paper currency.

s0310.literal: Because hail and river flooding damaged crops, twenty-two thousand eight hundred shi of land tax was remitted.
s0310.idiomatic: Because hail and river flooding damaged crops, 22,800 shi of land tax was remitted.

s0311.literal: Seven hundred-plus persons including Yisima were ordered to perform Buddhist rites and seated meditation at fifty-four assemblies in temples including Yuta Hall, the sleeping hall, Wanshou Mountain, and Huguo Renwang; Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan conducted a three-day jiao ritual.
s0311.idiomatic: More than 700 persons including Yisima were ordered to perform Buddhist rites and seated meditation at 54 assemblies in temples including Yuta Hall, the sleeping hall, Wanshou Mountain, and Huguo Renwang; Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan conducted a three-day jiao ritual.

s0312.literal: The Court of Imperial Entertainments was placed directly under the metropolitan secretariat.
s0312.idiomatic: The court of imperial entertainments was placed directly under the metropolitan secretariat.

s0313.literal: A Liquor Source Granary was established; yeast, rice, and medicines from the Grand Granary were divided off and placed under it.
s0313.idiomatic: A liquor source granary was established; yeast, rice, and medicines from the grand granary were divided off and placed under it.

s0314.literal: Junying City in Cangzhou was made Cangming County; Qingjiang County in Shizhou was placed under the Kuilu Route commission.
s0314.idiomatic: Junying City in Cangzhou was made Cangming County, and Qingjiang County in Shizhou was placed under the Kuilu Route commission.

s0316.literal: The Ministry of Revenue reported cultivating three thousand five hundred seventy qing of waste land, establishing over twenty-four thousand four hundred schools, and accumulating over three hundred fifteen thousand five hundred shi of charity grain.
s0316.idiomatic: The ministry of revenue reported cultivating 3,570 qing of waste land, establishing more than 24,400 schools, and accumulating more than 315,500 shi of charity grain.

s0317.literal: Ninety-five persons were sentenced to death.

s0318.literal: Twenty-sixth year, spring, first month, on bingxu day, earthquake.
s0318.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, on bingxu day of the first month of spring, there was an earthquake.

s0319.literal: An edict ordered Manwutai of Jianghuai province, Bulunishihaiya, and Yuedimishi to join forces and advance against bandit groups not yet suppressed.
s0319.idiomatic: An edict ordered Manwutai of Jianghuai province, Bulunishihaiya, and Yuedimishi to join forces and advance against bandit groups not yet suppressed.

s0320.literal: On jichou day troops were dispatched to block up the Tieli'er River between Shatuo.
s0320.idiomatic: On jichou day troops were dispatched to block the Tieli'er River between Shatuo.

s0321.literal: On xinmao day Badu Bulun reported his people, one thousand one hundred fifty-eight households, were impoverished; one hundred five thousand one hundred fifty liang of silver was granted.
s0321.idiomatic: On xinmao day Badu Bulun reported that 1,158 of his households were impoverished; 105,150 liang of silver was granted.

s0322.literal: The Jiangzhou general transport commission was moved to Longxing.
s0322.idiomatic: The Jiangzhou general transport commission was moved to Longxing.

s0323.literal: Shabuding reported the maritime trade bureau annually submitted four hundred jin of pearls and three thousand four hundred liang of gold; an edict ordered these stored for the needy.
s0323.idiomatic: Shabuding reported that the maritime trade bureau annually submitted 400 jin of pearls and 3,400 liang of gold; an edict ordered these stored for the needy.

s0325.literal: On wuxu day Tangwutai, left associate of Jinghu-Champa province, was made deputy to Adihuaduhe as Mongol commander in chief of ten thousand households, commanding troops joined from Jianghuai and Fujian provinces and Yuedimishi's forces to suppress bandits in Jiangxi.
s0325.idiomatic: On wuxu day Tangwutai, left associate of Jinghu-Champa province, was made deputy to Adihuaduhe as Mongol commander in chief of ten thousand households, commanding troops from Jianghuai and Fujian provinces and Yuedimishi's forces to suppress bandits in Jiangxi.

s0326.literal: Land taxes in Zhang and Ting prefectures were remitted.
s0326.idiomatic: Land taxes in Zhang and Ting prefectures were remitted.

s0327.literal: On xinchou day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers, Earth Altar, and Eastern and Southern Seas on the emperor's behalf.
s0327.idiomatic: On xinchou day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the mountains and rivers, Earth Altar, and Eastern and Southern Seas on the emperor's behalf.

s0328.literal: The Military Guard Select Army Command was established, with six thousand guard troops, three thousand military colony troops, and one thousand Jiangnan garrison troops, ten thousand total under its command.
s0328.idiomatic: The military guard select army command was established with 6,000 guard troops, 3,000 military colony troops, and 1,000 Jiangnan garrison troops—10,000 total under its command.

s0330.literal: On renyin day the Sea Ship Ten-Thousand Households Office said: "The Jiangnan grain transported by Shandong pacification commissioner Yue Shi is carried overland to Huai'an, passing seven locks before entering the sea, yielding only two hundred thousand shi per year.
s0330.idiomatic: On renyin day the sea ship ten-thousand households office said, "The Jiangnan grain transported by Shandong pacification commissioner Yue Shi is carried overland to Huai'an, passing seven locks before entering the sea, yielding only 200,000 shi per year.

s0331.literal: If it entered the river at Jiangyin and went to the Zhigu granary, the people would be spared overland transport hardship, and each shi of grain would save more than eight guan in transport costs.
s0331.idiomatic: If it entered the river at Jiangyin and went to the Zhigu granary, the people would be spared overland transport hardship, and each shi of grain would save more than 8 guan in transport costs.

s0332.literal: We ask that the Jiaolai sea-route grain transport ten-thousand households office be abolished and grain transport responsibility assigned to us; we can transport three hundred thousand shi this year.
s0332.idiomatic: We ask that the Jiaolai sea-route grain transport ten-thousand households office be abolished and grain transport responsibility assigned to us; we can transport 300,000 shi this year.

s0334.literal: On guimao day Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute goods.
s0334.idiomatic: On guimao day Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

s0335.literal: Bandit Zhong Mingliang attacked Ganzhou, plundered Ningdu, and held Xiuling; an edict dispatched five thousand garrison troops from Jianghuai province and neighboring prefectures, transferred Jiangxi associate administrator Guan Rude to left associate, and sent him to lead troops to suppress them.
s0335.idiomatic: Bandit Zhong Mingliang attacked Ganzhou, plundered Ningdu, and held Xiuling; an edict dispatched 5,000 garrison troops from Jianghuai province and neighboring prefectures, transferred Jiangxi associate administrator Guan Rude to left associate, and sent him to lead troops against them.

s0336.literal: She tribesman Qiu Dalao gathered a thousand men and attacked Changtai County; Fuzhou darughachi Tuohuan together with Zhangzhou Route prefect Gao Jie suppressed them.
s0336.idiomatic: She tribesman Qiu Dalao gathered 1,000 men and attacked Changtai County; Fuzhou darughachi Tuohuan and Zhangzhou Route prefect Gao Jie suppressed them.

s0337.literal: On jiachen day the Court of Imperial Entertainments was re-established.
s0337.idiomatic: On jiachen day the court of imperial entertainments was re-established.

s0338.literal: On wushen day the Guangzhou surveillance commission was moved to Shaozhou.
s0338.idiomatic: On wushen day the Guangzhou surveillance commission was moved to Shaozhou.

s0339.literal: Because the Jingnan surveillance commission's jurisdiction was too far-flung, three circuits were split off to Huai west and two circuits to Jiangxi.
s0339.idiomatic: Because the Jingnan surveillance commission's jurisdiction was too far-flung, three circuits were split off to Huai west and two circuits to Jiangxi.

s0340.literal: Fifteen relay stations were established from Xianping to Nieyan.
s0340.idiomatic: 15 relay stations were established from Xianping to Nieyan.

s0341.literal: The Ganzhou Route revenue intendant office was abolished and merged into the Ningxia general transport commission.
s0341.idiomatic: The Ganzhou Route revenue intendant office was abolished and merged into the Ningxia general transport commission.

s0342.literal: Associate administrator Zhang Shouzhi and Hanlin direct academician Li Tianying were dispatched as envoys to Goryeo to oversee assistance in grain for the Japan campaign.
s0342.idiomatic: Associate administrator Zhang Shouzhi and Hanlin direct academician Li Tianying were dispatched as envoys to Goryeo to oversee assistance in grain for the Japan campaign.

s0343.literal: Second month, xinhai new moon, an edict ordered registration of Jiangnan household population; all northerners of various categories residing there were also to be registered.
s0343.idiomatic: On the xinhai new moon of the second month, an edict ordered registration of Jiangnan household population; all northerners of various categories residing there were also to be registered.

s0344.literal: The Imperial Canal at Cangzhou was dredged.
s0344.idiomatic: The imperial canal at Cangzhou was dredged.

s0345.literal: On guichou day Aiyagachar requested that his troops garrison-farm at Xianping and Yizhou to save provisions.
s0345.idiomatic: On guichou day Aiyagachar requested that his troops garrison-farm at Xianping and Yizhou to save provisions.

s0346.literal: On jiwei day one thousand shi of grain from Karakorum was dispatched to relieve Prince Huonichi's dependents.
s0346.idiomatic: On jiwei day 1,000 shi of grain from Karakorum was dispatched to relieve Prince Huonichi's dependents.

s0347.literal: The Yanxi Directorate was established, third rank positive.
s0347.idiomatic: The Yanxi directorate was established at third rank positive.

s0348.literal: On renxu day Hemuli suffered famine; Gansu province was ordered to dispatch one thousand shi of rice for relief.
s0348.idiomatic: On renxu day Hemuli suffered famine; Gansu province was ordered to dispatch 1,000 shi of rice for relief.

s0349.literal: On guihai day an edict established the Chongfu Directorate at second rank negative.
s0349.idiomatic: On guihai day an edict established the Chongfu directorate at second rank negative.

s0350.literal: Jianghuai province headquarters was moved to Hangzhou; the Zhexi Circuit pacification commission was renamed Huaidong Circuit pacification commission, based at Yangzhou.
s0350.idiomatic: Jianghuai province headquarters was moved to Hangzhou; the Zhexi Circuit pacification commission was renamed Huaidong Circuit pacification commission, based at Yangzhou.

s0351.literal: On bingyin day Ministry officials said: "The fifteen thousand sea ships under the Quanzhou maritime office are manned by newly submitted people and are quite unusable in emergencies.
s0351.idiomatic: On bingyin day ministry officials said, "The 15,000 sea ships under the Quanzhou maritime office are manned by newly submitted people and are quite unusable in emergencies.

s0352.literal: It would be appropriate to recruit dispersed households of Nayan and Shengahe'er as troops, establish fifteen sea stations from Quanzhou to Hangzhou, each station with five ships and two hundred naval troops, dedicated to transporting foreign tribute goods and merchants' rare wares and also defending the sea route.
s0352.idiomatic: It would be appropriate to recruit dispersed households of Nayan and Shengahe'er as troops, establish 15 sea stations from Quanzhou to Hangzhou, each with 5 ships and 200 naval troops, dedicated to transporting foreign tribute goods and merchants' rare wares and also defending the sea route.

s0354.literal: Fujian branch secretariat Baijiang, Jiangxi branch commission Yuedimishi, and Jianghuai branch secretariat Manwutai were ordered to join forces against bandits in Jiangxi.
s0354.idiomatic: Fujian branch secretariat Baijiang, Jiangxi branch commission Yuedimishi, and Jianghuai branch secretariat Manwutai were ordered to join forces against bandits in Jiangxi.

s0355.literal: Dadu Route chief prefecture judge Xiao Yi had once been a clerk under Sangge; when his accepting bribes was discovered, the emperor spared his life and intended to exile him to gold-panning.
s0355.idiomatic: Dadu Route chief prefecture judge Xiao Yi had once been a clerk under Sangge; when his accepting bribes was discovered, the emperor spared his life and intended to exile him to gold-panning.

s0356.literal: Sangge argued that Yi had once audited the trillion treasury and had ability to recover funds, sufficient to redeem his life; he should be dismissed from office and beaten before exile; the emperor reluctantly agreed.
s0356.idiomatic: Sangge argued that Yi had once audited the trillion treasury and had ability to recover funds, sufficient to redeem his life; he should be dismissed from office and beaten before exile, and the emperor reluctantly agreed.

s0357.literal: On dingmao day the emperor proceeded to Shangdu.
s0357.idiomatic: On dingmao day the emperor proceeded to Shangdu.

s0358.literal: Right chancellor of the central secretariat Bayan was made privy council overseer, commanding all northern frontier armies.
s0358.idiomatic: Right chancellor of the central secretariat Bayan was made privy council overseer, commanding all northern frontier armies.

s0359.literal: Chengdu garrison commander in chief Liu Delu memorialized, willing to use five thousand troops to induce the eight tribes of barbarians to submit and thereby advance against Jiaozhi.
s0359.idiomatic: Chengdu garrison commander in chief Liu Delu memorialized, offering to use 5,000 troops to induce the eight tribes of barbarians to submit and thereby advance against Jiaozhi.

s0360.literal: The privy council requested establishing a marshal command; Yalihan and Delu were both made commanders in chief; ten thousand Sichuan troops were assigned to it; the emperor agreed.
s0360.idiomatic: The privy council requested establishing a marshal command; Yalihan and Delu were both made commanders in chief; 10,000 Sichuan troops were assigned to it, and the emperor agreed.

s0361.literal: Bada'er was made associate chancellor of the central secretariat.
s0361.idiomatic: Bada'er was made associate chancellor of the central secretariat.

s0362.literal: Shaoxing suffered great flooding; unpaid land taxes were remitted.
s0362.idiomatic: Shaoxing suffered great flooding; unpaid land taxes were remitted.

s0363.literal: Hedan troops raided Hulukou; Kaiyuan Route assistant prefect Wuyan Yawuge fought for successive days and defeated them.
s0363.idiomatic: Hedan troops raided Hulukou; Kaiyuan Route assistant prefect Wuyan Yawuge fought for successive days and defeated them.

s0364.literal: On jisi day left and right wing military colony commander offices were established, third rank negative.
s0364.idiomatic: On jisi day left and right wing military colony commander offices were established at third rank negative.

s0365.literal: Yululu memorialized that bandits in Jiangnan numbered over four hundred locations; generals should be selected to suppress them.
s0365.idiomatic: Yululu memorialized that bandits in Jiangnan numbered more than 400 locations; generals should be selected to suppress them.

s0366.literal: The Emperor said: "Yuedimishi has repeatedly reported victories; Manwutai has already gone—you need not worry.
s0366.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Yuedimishi has repeatedly reported victories; Manwutai has already gone—you need not worry.

s0367.literal: " Imperial grandson Ganbula's troops lacked food; grain from Datong Route monopoly markets was dispatched for relief.
s0367.idiomatic: Imperial grandson Ganbula's troops lacked food; grain from Datong Route monopoly markets was dispatched for relief.

s0368.literal: On jiaxu day Wang Weihe, convenient-command general of Gongchang, was ordered to lead his ten thousand troops on the northern campaign, commanded to receive orders at court before crossing the pass.
s0368.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Wang Weihe, convenient-command general of Gongchang, was ordered to lead his 10,000 troops on the northern campaign, commanded to receive orders at court before crossing the pass.

s0369.literal: On yihai day six military colony directorates were consolidated into a farming intendant office.
s0369.idiomatic: On yihai day six military colony directorates were consolidated into a farming intendant office.

s0370.literal: Third month, gengchen new moon, eclipse of the sun.
s0370.idiomatic: On the gengchen new moon of the third month, there was a solar eclipse.

s0371.literal: Taizhou bandit Yang Zhenlong gathered a host at Ninghai, usurped the title Great Xing Kingdom, raided Dongyang and Yiwu; eastern Zhejiang was greatly alarmed.
s0371.idiomatic: Taizhou bandit Yang Zhenlong gathered a host at Ninghai, usurped the title Great Xing Kingdom, raided Dongyang and Yiwu, and eastern Zhejiang was greatly alarmed.

s0372.literal: Prince Onggedai, then demoted to Juzhou, led troops to suppress him.
s0372.idiomatic: Prince Onggedai, then demoted to Juzhou, led troops to suppress him.

s0373.literal: Yunnan military colony was established to supply military stores.
s0373.idiomatic: A Yunnan military colony was established to supply military stores.

s0374.literal: Sangge said: "Completed cases at the ministries are all financial matters; censorial officials should audit them on the spot at the ministries, writing their names at the end of each scroll, and attendant censor Jiantong should oversee this; failure would entail joint punishment.
s0374.idiomatic: Sangge said, "Completed cases at the ministries are all financial matters; censorial officials should audit them on the spot at the ministries, writing their names at the end of each scroll, and attendant censor Jiantong should oversee this; failure would entail joint punishment.

s0376.literal: Anxi suffered famine; twenty thousand shi of rice was sold at reduced price.
s0376.idiomatic: Anxi suffered famine; 20,000 shi of rice was sold at reduced price.

s0377.literal: Ganzhou suffered famine; ten thousand ingots of paper currency were issued for relief.
s0377.idiomatic: Ganzhou suffered famine; 10,000 ingots of paper currency were issued for relief.

s0378.literal: On jichou day farm tools and seed grain were granted to the Shaanxi military colony commission.
s0378.idiomatic: On jichou day farm tools and seed grain were granted to the Shaanxi military colony commission.

s0379.literal: On guisi day Dongliu County presented ganoderma.
s0379.idiomatic: On guisi day Dongliu County presented ganoderma.

s0380.literal: On jiawu day the moon transgressed Kang.
s0380.idiomatic: On jiawu day the moon transgressed Kang.

s0381.literal: On yiwei day casting of the armillary sphere was completed.
s0381.idiomatic: On yiwei day casting of the armillary sphere was completed.

s0382.literal: On guisi day Jinchi native Saiwan came to submit with his people, over two hundred one thousand households, and also presented three elephants.
s0382.idiomatic: On guisi day Jinchi native Saiwan came to submit with his people, more than 201,000 households, and also presented 3 elephants.

s0383.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiyou day the farming directorate was re-established at Ningxia Prefecture.
s0383.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on jiyou day the farming directorate was re-established at Ningxia Prefecture.

s0384.literal: Famine within Liaoyang province; sixty thousand shi of Goryeo rice was loaned for relief.
s0384.idiomatic: Famine within Liaoyang province; 60,000 shi of Goryeo rice was loaned for relief.

s0385.literal: On renzi day Boluodai reported household numbers gathered at Bie Shibali; Gansu province was ordered to provide relief.
s0385.idiomatic: On renzi day Boluodai reported household numbers gathered at Bie Shibali; Gansu province was ordered to provide relief.

s0386.literal: On guichou day Tahai was ordered to deploy troops under Hubuduhua and others, encamping north of Gou Station to repel raiders.
s0386.idiomatic: On guichou day Tahai was ordered to deploy troops under Hubuduhua and others, encamping north of Gou Station to repel raiders.

s0387.literal: Baoqing Route suffered famine; eleven thousand shi of rice was sold at reduced price.
s0387.idiomatic: Baoqing Route suffered famine; 11,000 shi of rice was sold at reduced price.

s0388.literal: On bingchen day Gansu branch secretariat was ordered to supply grain to the hungry among Hede's dependents.
s0388.idiomatic: On bingchen day Gansu branch secretariat was ordered to supply grain to the hungry among Hede's dependents.

s0389.literal: On dingsi day palace eunuchs were dispatched to inspect impoverished commoners of Prince Anhui and supply them with grain.
s0389.idiomatic: On dingsi day palace eunuchs were dispatched to inspect impoverished commoners of Prince Anhui and supply them with grain.

s0390.literal: On wuwu day Jiangnan commoners were forbidden to carry bows and arrows; violators were registered for military service.
s0390.idiomatic: On wuwu day Jiangnan commoners were forbidden to carry bows and arrows; violators were registered for military service.

s0391.literal: The Jiangxi-Fujian hunting and falconry commission was established; the Fujian transport commission and garrison commander said it was inappropriate; an edict abolished it.
s0391.idiomatic: The Jiangxi-Fujian hunting and falconry commission was established; the Fujian transport commission and garrison commander said it was inappropriate, and an edict abolished it.

s0392.literal: Seven Jianghuai military colony hunting intendant offices were consolidated; those remaining were Xupi, Haizhou, Yangzhou, Lianghuai, Huai'an, Gaoyou, Zhaoxin, Anfeng, Zhenchao, Qihuang, Yuwang, and Shijiu—twelve offices still.
s0392.idiomatic: Seven Jianghuai military colony hunting intendant offices were consolidated; those remaining were Xupi, Haizhou, Yangzhou, Lianghuai, Huai'an, Gaoyou, Zhaoxin, Anfeng, Zhenchao, Qihuang, Yuwang, and Shijiu—12 offices still.

s0393.literal: On jiazi day Wang Mian of Guichi County, Chizhou, presented twelve stalks of purple ganoderma.
s0393.idiomatic: On jiazi day Wang Mian of Guichi County, Chizhou, presented 12 stalks of purple ganoderma.

s0394.literal: On wuchen day Annam king Chen Ri-xuan sent his grand master Chen Keyong and others to present tribute goods.
s0394.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Annam king Chen Ri-xuan sent his grand master Chen Keyong and others to present tribute goods.

s0395.literal: On jisi day Kierjisi households residing at Karakorum—those found impoverished were given relief.
s0395.idiomatic: On jisi day Kierjisi households residing at Karakorum—those found impoverished were given relief.

s0396.literal: On gengwu day the Sha River breached; commoners were mobilized to build dikes to contain it.
s0396.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Sha River breached; commoners were mobilized to build dikes to contain it.

s0397.literal: On guiyou day because Goryeo produced much silver, artisans were dispatched there and nearby commoners were mobilized to smelt and deliver to the state.
s0397.idiomatic: On guiyou day because Goryeo produced much silver, artisans were dispatched there and nearby commoners were mobilized to smelt and deliver to the state.

s0398.literal: The Laiwu iron smelting intendant office was placed under the Shandong salt transport commission.
s0398.idiomatic: The Laiwu iron smelting intendant office was placed under the Shandong salt transport commission.

s0399.literal: On jiaxu day censor-in-chief Yululu was made grand tutor, granted opening-of-government with equal ceremonies to the Three Dukes, and made overseer of the Jiangxi branch ministry secretariat.
s0399.idiomatic: On jiaxu day censor-in-chief Yululu was made grand tutor, granted opening-of-government with equal ceremonies to the Three Dukes, and made overseer of the Jiangxi branch ministry secretariat.

s0400.literal: Associate administrator Xindu of Jianghuai branch secretariat was summoned to court; Minister of Revenue Wang Juji was put in charge of auditing Jianghuai province, under left chancellor Manwutai.
s0400.idiomatic: Associate administrator Xindu of Jianghuai branch secretariat was summoned to court; minister of revenue Wang Juji was put in charge of auditing Jianghuai province under left chancellor Manwutai.
